1. (S) SITUATION:
A Soviet support ship is anchored west of Sabang to refuel and rearm units screening the Sunda approaches. The vessel is operating under a local patrol screen and is vulnerable while stopped, but the area will close rapidly once an attack is detected.
2. (S) MISSION: 2.1 Destroy the Soviet support ship. 2.2 {TaskForceFlagshipName} must survive.
3. (S) EXECUTION: 3.1 Infiltrate the marked Sabang approaches submerged and maintain emissions control until the target is identified. 3.2 Conduct a deliberate torpedo attack against the support ship when a high-confidence solution is available. 3.3 After weapons release, break contact immediately and proceed to the marked escape area to the southwest. 3.4 Do not remain in the anchorage to assess damage. Survival of the boat is essential to the operation.
4. (S) ENEMY SITUATION: 4.1 The support ship is expected to be under escort by patrol craft operating around the anchorage. 4.2 Local surface forces may converge from Sabang or the Sunda approaches after the attack.
5. (S) FRIENDLY SITUATION: 5.1 {TaskForceFlagshipName} is operating independently without a supporting surface screen. 5.2 Coalition forces will not enter the target area during the strike window. 5.3 The escape area is the planned recovery point for the operation.
6. (S) INTEL ASSESSMENT: 6.1 Light winds, moderate haze, and scattered showers favor a submerged approach but may complicate post-strike navigation. 6.2 Soviet patrols are expected to react aggressively once the support ship is hit. 6.3 The target is valuable for the wider campaign, but no second attack attempt is authorized if the first approach fails.
